objectives.en: I can name common places in a town.
objectives.he: אני יכול/ה לקרוא בשם למקומות נפוצים בעיר באנגלית.

objectives.en: I can say where places are with next to, between, opposite, behind, in front of and near.
objectives.he: אני יודע/ת לומר איפה נמצאים מקומות בעזרת next to, between, opposite, behind, in front of ו-near.

objectives.en: I can choose in, on or at for a place.
objectives.he: אני יודע/ת לבחור בין in, on ו-at כשמדברים על מקום.

objectives.en: I can ask where a place is and understand a short answer.
objectives.he: אני יכול/ה לשאול איפה נמצא מקום ולהבין תשובה קצרה.

warmup.en: Think of your street. What is near your home: a shop, a café, a bus stop? Try to say one sentence in English about where it is.
warmup.he: חשבו על הרחוב שלכם. מה נמצא ליד הבית: חנות, בית קפה, תחנת אוטובוס? נסו לומר משפט אחד באנגלית על המקום שבו זה נמצא.

explanation.en: Excuse me, where's the bank? – It's on Herzl Street, between the café and the pharmacy. The post office is opposite the bank.
explanation.he: סליחה, איפה הבנק? – ברחוב הרצל, בין בית הקפה לבית המרקחת. הדואר נמצא מול הבנק. באנגלית מילת המקום (between, opposite) באה לפני המקום, ובמשפט תמיד יש is או are.

rows: right beside, on the same side
The bank is next to the café.
with one place on each side
The café is between the bank and the pharmacy.
on the other side of the street, facing it
The park is opposite the café.
The car park is behind the bank.
just before it, on the same side
The bus stop is in front of the pharmacy.
My flat is near the beach.

explanation.en: in = inside a building or an area: in the kitchen, in the park, in Haifa. on = on a surface or a side: on the table, on the wall, on the left, on the second floor. at = at a point, or a place where you do something: at the bus stop, at home, at work, at school.
explanation.he: in = בתוך בניין או שטח: in the kitchen, in the park, in Haifa. ‏on = על משטח או בצד: on the table, on the wall, on the left, on the second floor. ‏at = בנקודה מסוימת, או במקום שבו עושים משהו: at the bus stop, at home, at work, at school.

explanation.en: Keep all the small words: next to the bank (not 'next the bank'), in front of the bank (not 'in front the bank'), between the bank and the café (with and). After opposite, add nothing: opposite the bank.
explanation.he: אל תשמיטו את המילים הקטנות: next to the bank (ולא next the bank), ‏in front of the bank (ולא in front the bank), ‏between the bank and the café (עם and). אחרי opposite לא מוסיפים כלום: opposite the bank.

explanation.en: Asking the way: Excuse me, where's the bank? / Is there a pharmacy near here? Answers: It's next to the café. / Yes, there's one opposite the park.
explanation.he: כשמבקשים הכוונה שואלים: Excuse me, where's the bank? או Is there a pharmacy near here? ועונים: It's next to the café, או Yes, there's one opposite the park.

examples.en: The pharmacy is next to the supermarket.
The café is between the bank and the post office.
The cinema is opposite the park.
examples.note: on the other side of the street

examples.en: There's a car park behind the hospital.
I'm in front of the library. Where are you?
Excuse me, where's the bus stop? – It's on the corner.
My keys are on the table, and my phone is in my bag.
examples.he: המפתחות שלי על השולחן, והטלפון שלי בתיק.

examples.en: Is there a bank near here?
examples.note: Is there...? from the last lesson

vocab.def: a place where people keep and take out money
vocab.example: The bank is next to the café.

vocab.def: a shop where you can buy medicine (UK also: chemist's; US also: drugstore)
vocab.example: Is there a pharmacy near here?

vocab.def: a big shop that sells food and things for the home
vocab.example: There's a supermarket on the corner.

vocab.def: a place where you send letters and parcels
vocab.example: The post office is opposite the bank.

vocab.def: a place in the street where a bus stops for people
vocab.example: Wait for me at the bus stop.

vocab.def: a building where you can read or borrow books
vocab.example: The library is quiet in the morning.

vocab.def: a place where you watch films (US: movie theater)
vocab.example: The cinema is in the shopping centre.

vocab.def: a big building where doctors and nurses help sick people
vocab.example: There's a car park behind the hospital.

vocab.def: a place where you leave your car (US: parking lot)
vocab.example: The car park is behind the supermarket.

vocab.def: a big building with a lot of shops (US: mall)
vocab.example: Is there a shopping centre near here?

vocab.def: the place where two streets meet
vocab.example: There's a café on the corner.

vocab.def: on the other side of a street or room, facing something
vocab.example: The park is opposite my building.

vocab.def: with one thing on one side and another thing on the other side
vocab.example: The café is between the bank and the pharmacy.

hebrew_pitfalls.en: In Hebrew there is no present-tense 'be', so 'The bank next to the café' can sound complete. English works differently: it needs is. The bank is next to the café. Where's (= Where is) the bank?
hebrew_pitfalls.he: בעברית אין 'להיות' בהווה, ולכן 'The bank next to the café' נשמע אולי שלם. באנגלית חייבים is: The bank is next to the café. וגם בשאלה: Where's the bank? (Where is).

hebrew_pitfalls.en: In Hebrew a question can keep the word order of a normal sentence. English works differently: is comes before the place. Where is the station? (not 'Where the station is?')
hebrew_pitfalls.he: בעברית שאלה יכולה לשמור על סדר המילים של משפט רגיל. באנגלית is בא לפני המקום: Where is the station? ולא Where the station is?

hebrew_pitfalls.en: In Hebrew the sound /ŋ/ is not a separate sound (it only comes before g or k), so shopping and building can end with an extra g, or with n. In English, -ing ends in /ŋ/ alone: /ˈʃɒpɪŋ/.
hebrew_pitfalls.he: בעברית /ŋ/ אינו צליל נפרד (הוא מופיע רק לפני g או k), ולכן shopping ו-building יוצאות לפעמים עם g נוספת בסוף, או עם n. באנגלית ing מסתיים בצליל /ŋ/ בלבד, בלי g: shopping.

prompt.en: Match the places with their Hebrew meaning.
prompt.he: התאימו כל מקום באנגלית למשמעות שלו בעברית.

explanation.en: These are British words. In the US people often say drugstore (pharmacy), parking lot (car park) and mall (shopping centre).
explanation.he: אלה המילים הבריטיות. בארה״ב אומרים לרוב drugstore (בית מרקחת), parking lot (חניון) ו-mall (קניון).

prompt.en: in, on or at? Sort the places.
prompt.he: in, ‏on או at? מיינו את המקומות.

hint.en: Inside something? A surface or a side? Or a point / an activity?
hint.he: בתוך משהו? על משטח או בצד? או בנקודה, או במקום של פעילות?

explanation.en: in = inside (a city, a room, a pocket). on = a surface or a side (the wall, the left, a floor of a building). at = a point or a place for an activity (the bus stop, home, work).
explanation.he: in = בתוך (עיר, חדר, כיס). ‏on = על משטח או בצד (קיר, שמאל, קומה בבניין). ‏at = בנקודה או במקום של פעילות (תחנת אוטובוס, בית, עבודה).

prompt.en: Look at the street and choose the correct word.
prompt.he: הסתכלו על הרחוב ובחרו את המילה הנכונה.

exercises.question: Street: BANK – CAFÉ – PHARMACY (all on one side). The café is ___ the bank and the pharmacy.

0.en: opposite = on the other side of the street. The café is on the same side, in the middle.
0.he: opposite = בצד השני של הרחוב. בית הקפה באותו צד, באמצע.

2.en: behind = at the back of something. The café is in the middle, with a place on each side.
2.he: behind = מאחורי משהו. בית הקפה באמצע, ויש מקום מכל צד שלו.

3.en: in front of is for one place. Here there are two places and the word and, so use between.
3.he: in front of מתייחס למקום אחד. כאן יש שני מקומות והמילה and, ולכן between.

explanation.en: between + one place + and + another place: between the bank and the pharmacy.
explanation.he: between + מקום אחד + and + מקום שני: between the bank and the pharmacy.

prompt.en: Someone asks for the post office. Listen and answer.
prompt.he: מישהו שואל איפה הדואר. הקשיבו וענו.

exercises.audio_text: The post office? It's opposite the bank, next to the park.
exercises.question: Where is the post office?

1.en: The bank is on the other side of the street: 'opposite the bank'. The post office is next to the park.
1.he: הבנק בצד השני של הרחוב: 'opposite the bank'. הדואר נמצא ליד הפארק.

2.en: The post office is next to the park, not opposite it.

explanation.en: 'It's opposite the bank, next to the park': it faces the bank and is beside the park.
explanation.he: 'It's opposite the bank, next to the park' – הדואר מול הבנק, וליד הפארק.

prompt.en: Complete the message with in, on or at.
prompt.he: השלימו את ההודעה ב-in, ב-on או ב-at.

exercises.text: Sorry, I'm ___ work. Your keys are ___ the table ___ the kitchen.
answers: at
on
in

feedback.en: in = inside a room or an area: in the kitchen. Work takes at, and the table takes on.
feedback.he: in = בתוך חדר או שטח: in the kitchen. עם work אומרים at, ועם the table אומרים on.

feedback.en: on = on a surface: on the table. Say at work and in the kitchen.
feedback.he: on = על משטח: on the table. אומרים at work ו-in the kitchen.

feedback.en: at = a point or a place for an activity: at work. Say on the table and in the kitchen.
feedback.he: at = נקודה או מקום של פעילות: at work. אומרים on the table ו-in the kitchen.

explanation.en: at work (a place where you do something) · on the table (a surface) · in the kitchen (inside a room).
explanation.he: at work (מקום שבו עושים משהו) · on the table (משטח) · in the kitchen (בתוך חדר).

exercises.question: The car park is ___ the supermarket, so you can't see it from the street.

0.en: in front of = between the street and the supermarket, so you can see it. This car park is at the back.
0.he: in front of = בין הרחוב לסופרמרקט, ולכן רואים אותו. החניון הזה נמצא מאחור.

1.en: between needs two places: between the bank and the café.
1.he: between צריך שני מקומות: between the bank and the café.

2.en: next needs to: next to. And here the car park is at the back, so behind.
2.he: אחרי next חייב לבוא to: next to. וחוץ מזה החניון מאחור, ולכן behind.

explanation.en: behind = at the back of something, so you can't see it from the front.
explanation.he: behind = מאחורי משהו, ולכן לא רואים אותו מלפנים.

prompt.en: Read the description of the street and complete the sentences.
prompt.he: קראו את התיאור של הרחוב והשלימו את המשפטים.

exercises.text: Herzl Street: a bank, then a café, then a pharmacy. On the other side of the street, facing the café: a park. At the back of the bank: a car park. Now complete: The bank is ___ the café. The park is ___ the café. The car park is ___ the bank.
answers: next to
opposite
behind

hint.en: Same side, other side of the street, or at the back?
hint.he: באותו צד, בצד השני של הרחוב, או מאחור?

feedback.en: opposite = on the other side of the street, facing it. Only the park is opposite the café.
feedback.he: opposite = בצד השני של הרחוב, מול. רק הפארק נמצא מול בית הקפה.

feedback.en: next to = right beside, on the same side. The park is across the street, and the car park is at the back.
feedback.he: next to = ממש ליד, באותו צד. הפארק בצד השני של הרחוב, והחניון מאחור.

feedback.en: behind = at the back. Only the car park is behind something (the bank).
feedback.he: behind = מאחור. רק החניון נמצא מאחורי משהו (הבנק).

explanation.en: The bank is next to the café (same side). The park is opposite the café (other side, facing it). The car park is behind the bank (at the back).
explanation.he: הבנק ליד בית הקפה (באותו צד) – next to. הפארק מול בית הקפה (בצד השני) – opposite. החניון מאחורי הבנק – behind.

prompt.en: This sentence has a mistake. Write it correctly.
prompt.he: במשפט יש טעות. כתבו אותו נכון.

exercises.sentence: The bus stop is in front the pharmacy.
answers: The bus stop is in front of the pharmacy.

explanation.en: in front of is three words: The bus stop is in front of the pharmacy.
explanation.he: in front of הוא צירוף של שלוש מילים: The bus stop is in front of the pharmacy.

exercises.sentence: Excuse me, where the bank is?
answers: Excuse me, where is the bank?
Excuse me where is the bank?

feedback.en: Keep the verb, and put it before the bank: Where is the bank?
feedback.he: הפועל חייב להישאר, ולבוא לפני the bank: Where is the bank?

explanation.en: In a question, is comes before the subject: Where is (Where's) the bank?
explanation.he: בשאלה is בא לפני הנושא: Where is the bank? (או בקיצור Where's the bank?)

answers: The pharmacy is next to the bank.
The pharmacy is near the bank.
The pharmacy is beside the bank.
The pharmacy is close to the bank.
The pharmacy's next to the bank.
The pharmacy's near the bank.
The pharmacy's beside the bank.
The pharmacy's close to the bank.
The chemist's is next to the bank.
The chemist's is near the bank.
The drugstore is next to the bank.
The drugstore is near the bank.

hint.en: The Hebrew word can mean next to or near. And remember the verb!
hint.he: 'ליד' יכול להיות next to או near. ואל תשכחו את הפועל!

wrong_feedback.match: The pharmacy next to the bank.

feedback.en: The Hebrew sentence has no verb, but English needs is: The pharmacy is next to the bank.
feedback.he: במשפט בעברית אין פועל, אבל באנגלית חייבים is: The pharmacy is next to the bank.

wrong_feedback.match: The pharmacy is next the bank.

feedback.en: next always has to after it: next to the bank.
feedback.he: אחרי next תמיד בא to: next to the bank.

wrong_feedback.match: Pharmacy is next to the bank.

feedback.en: Use the for a place you both know: The pharmacy is next to the bank.
feedback.he: כשמדברים על מקום ששניכם מכירים, משתמשים ב-the: The pharmacy is next to the bank.

explanation.en: The pharmacy is next to (or near) the bank. English needs is, and next always comes with to.
explanation.he: The pharmacy is next to (או near) the bank. באנגלית חייבים is, ו-next תמיד בא עם to.

prompt.en: Put the words in order to make a question.

explanation.en: Is there + a place + near + somewhere? In the question, Is comes before there.
explanation.he: Is there + מקום + near + איפה? בשאלה Is בא לפני there.

prompt.en: Read the notice for guests at a hostel and answer the questions.
prompt.he: קראו את ההודעה לאורחים באכסניה וענו על השאלות.

exercises.title: Welcome to Palm Tree Hostel
exercises.passage: Welcome to Palm Tree Hostel! Here are some useful places near us. The bus stop is right in front of the hostel, and the number 5 bus goes to the beach. There's a small supermarket on the corner, next to a pharmacy. The bank is opposite the supermarket. The post office is between the bank and a nice café. Do you need a bike? There's a bike shop behind the hostel. Questions? Ask us at reception. Have a great stay!

0.en: The bike shop is behind the hostel. The bus stop is in front of it.
0.he: חנות האופניים נמצאת מאחורי האכסניה. תחנת האוטובוס – מלפניה.

1.en: The supermarket is opposite the bank. The bus stop is 'right in front of the hostel'.
1.he: הסופרמרקט נמצא מול הבנק. תחנת האוטובוס 'right in front of the hostel'.

explanation.en: 'The bus stop is right in front of the hostel.'
explanation.he: 'The bus stop is right in front of the hostel' – התחנה ממש מול הכניסה לאכסניה.

questions.statement: The pharmacy is next to the supermarket.

explanation.en: 'There's a small supermarket on the corner, next to a pharmacy.'
explanation.he: 'There's a small supermarket on the corner, next to a pharmacy' – הם זה ליד זה.

questions.statement: The bank is next to the supermarket.

explanation.en: 'The bank is opposite the supermarket' – on the other side of the street.
explanation.he: 'The bank is opposite the supermarket' – הבנק בצד השני של הרחוב, מול הסופרמרקט.

questions.question: What is between the bank and the café?

1.en: The pharmacy is next to the supermarket, on the corner.

2.en: The supermarket is opposite the bank, not next to it.

explanation.en: 'The post office is between the bank and a nice café.'
explanation.he: 'The post office is between the bank and a nice café' – הדואר באמצע.

questions.text: There's a bike shop ___ the hostel.
answers: behind

explanation.en: 'There's a bike shop behind the hostel' – at the back of it.
explanation.he: 'There's a bike shop behind the hostel' – מאחורי האכסניה.

prompt.en: Listen and type what you hear.

exercises.audio_text: The library is opposite the park, next to the cinema.
answers: The library is opposite the park, next to the cinema.

hint.en: Two places: one across the street, one beside it.
hint.he: שני מקומות: אחד בצד השני של הרחוב, ואחד ממש לידה.

explanation.en: opposite the park (other side of the street), next to the cinema (beside it). library: three syllables, LI-bra-ry.
explanation.he: opposite the park – בצד השני של הרחוב; next to the cinema – ממש ליד. ‏library: שלוש הברות, LI-bra-ry.

prompt.en: You're new in town. Ask a stranger. Say the question out loud.
prompt.he: אתם חדשים בעיר. שאלו מישהו ברחוב. אמרו את השאלה בקול.

exercises.target: Excuse me, is there a shopping centre near here?

focus.en: shopping ends in /ŋ/: no g sound after it. In a yes/no question, your voice goes up at the end.
focus.he: shopping מסתיימת בצליל /ŋ/ – בלי g אחריו. בשאלת כן/לא הקול עולה בסוף.

explanation.en: A useful question in any new town. Answers often start with Yes, there's one... or It's...
explanation.he: שאלה שימושית בכל עיר חדשה. התשובה מתחילה בדרך כלל ב-Yes, there's one... או ב-It's...

task.en: Write 5-6 sentences about the area where you live (or a street you know well). Name at least four places and say where they are. Use next to, opposite and one more (between, behind, in front of or near).
task.he: כתבו 5-6 משפטים על האזור שבו אתם גרים (או על רחוב שאתם מכירים היטב). ציינו לפחות ארבעה מקומות וכתבו איפה הם נמצאים. השתמשו ב-next to, ב-opposite ובעוד מילה אחת (between, behind, in front of או near).

exercises.model_answer: I live in a flat on Hagefen Street in Haifa. There's a small supermarket next to my building. Opposite the supermarket, there's a park. The bus stop is in front of the park, so it's easy to get to work. There's a pharmacy on the corner, between a bank and a café. The library is near the café.

checklist.en: Every sentence has a verb: The bank is..., There's a...
checklist.he: בכל משפט יש פועל: The bank is..., There's a...

checklist.en: I kept all the small words: next to, in front of, between ... and ...
checklist.he: שמרתי על כל המילים הקטנות: next to, in front of, between ... and ...

checklist.en: a/an the first time I mention a place: There's a park.
checklist.he: a/an כשאני מזכיר/ה מקום בפעם הראשונה: There's a park.

checklist.en: Street and city names start with a capital letter.
checklist.he: שמות של רחובות וערים מתחילים באות גדולה.

explanation.en: The model names six places and uses a different preposition for each one, always with is or there's.
explanation.he: בתשובה לדוגמה יש שישה מקומות, ולכל אחד מילת מקום אחרת – תמיד עם is או there's.

key_points.en: next to · between ... and ... · opposite · behind · in front of · near + the place: The bank is next to the café.
key_points.he: next to · between ... and ... · opposite · behind · in front of · near + המקום: The bank is next to the café.

key_points.en: in = inside (in the kitchen) · on = a surface or a side (on the table, on the left) · at = a point (at the bus stop, at home, at work).
key_points.he: in = בתוך (in the kitchen) · ‏on = על משטח או בצד (on the table, on the left) · ‏at = בנקודה (at the bus stop, at home, at work).

key_points.en: Always use be: The bank is opposite the park. Ask: Where is...? / Is there a ... near here?
key_points.he: תמיד עם be: The bank is opposite the park. שואלים: Where is...? או Is there a ... near here?
